name: librarian
description: Curates, catalogs, retrieves, and maintains your library of notes and knowledge in an Obsidian vault. Workflow-shaped (Capture / Process / Retrieve / Maintain) and agent-mediated (skills draft, agents execute). 16 skills + 4 agents + 7 references, coupled to the vault conventions in ~/Loose Ends/.claude/rules/{wiki.md,catalog.md}.
